[[File:Three-Pilalrs-TJP.png|thumb|right|Illustration from [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]]]
The '''Three Pillars''' were the core tenets of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], namely the [[The Force/Legends|Force]], Knowledge, and Self-Discipline. The [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] main entrance statuary resembled the three pillars.<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
